tools.name: studio_status
tools.description: Say which Video Maker studio this session is connected to (apiUrl, where it was found: desktop app, dev studio or environment), its version and whether its engine, binaries and producer are healthy. Call it first; if it fails, ask the user to open the Video Maker app.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List what the studio engine can do today: output formats, project modes, montage presets and transitions, motion scene kinds, exits and title styles, bumper backgrounds and reveals, text overlay kinds and variants, the sound effects bank, voices, job kinds and asset roles. Read it before writing a brief or storyboard instead of assuming.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the video projects of the studio (slug, mode, brand, title, layout flags and last publication).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new video project. `slug` is kebab-case and unique; `mode` is footage (montage of recordings, default) or motion (animated video made from a brief and storyboard); `brand` is a brand id from list_brands. Fails when the slug exists.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

brand.description: Brand id to apply to the project

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Upload a local file into a project as raw material: it lands in raw/<role>/<filename> and is cataloged. `role` is aroll (main footage or screen recording), broll, image, audio (music), voice (narration), logo or reference. Fails when that filename already exists in the project.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

filePath.description: Absolute path of a file on this machine (for example in the repository you are working in)

filename.description: Name to store it under; defaults to the local file name

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands the studio has (built-in and user-made).

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Read one brand: its manifest (colors, fonts, tone, music) and the files it carries.

tools.name: create_brand
tools.description: Create a user brand from a name (optionally with an id, or duplicating another brand with duplicateFrom). Then fill it in with update_brand and upload_brand_file.

duplicateFrom.description: Id of an existing brand to start from

tools.name: update_brand
tools.description: Replace the manifest of a user brand. Send the whole manifest as read with get_brand (same `id`); files it references must already be uploaded with upload_brand_file. Built-in brands cannot be changed.

tools.name: upload_brand_file
tools.description: Upload a local file into a user brand: kind is logo, image, font, music or device. The studio validates the extension for the kind.

filePath.description: Absolute path of a file on this machine (for example in the repository you are working in)

name.description: Name to store it under; defaults to the local file name

tools.name: import_brand_music
tools.description: Add a free-licensed track found with search_free_music to the music bank of a user brand, without downloading anything yourself: the studio downloads it (mp3, wav or m4a only), stores it in the brand and appends the track to the manifest with its credit and license. `slug` is the project whose search_free_music call returned `resultId` (valid for one hour); `bpm` and `mood` are yours to estimate. Afterwards the track id works in the brief `music` field.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

resultId.description: resultId from a search_free_music result (not a brand bank one)

bpm.description: Tempo of the track in beats per minute

mood.description: A few words describing the track, used to match it to a video

trackId.description: Id for the track in the brand bank; defaults to a slug of its title

tools.name: get_project_overview
tools.description: Get a snapshot of the current project: its assets, whether a timeline or script already exists, and its most recent jobs. Call this first to orient yourself before doing anything else. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: probe_media
tools.description: Inspect a media file already inside the project (duration, video and audio streams) without running ffprobe yourself. Use it to measure raw material before editing. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: extract_frames
tools.description: Extract up to 12 still frames from a video at the given timestamps and get them back as images plus their saved paths. Use it to look at footage instead of running ffmpeg. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the text-to-speech voices available for the voice job, including the default one.

tools.name: read_project_text
tools.description: Read a small text, markdown, JSON or SRT file from inside the project (under work/), up to 256 KB. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: write_project_text
tools.description: Write a text file inside the project, only under work/producer/ or work/credits.json. Parent directories are created automatically. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: copy_asset
tools.description: Copy an existing file inside the project into raw/<role>/<filename>. Fails if the destination already exists and never deletes the source. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Start an asynchronous render engine job and get back its id and initial status. Poll it with wait_for_job. Pass the job under "job"; its "kind" — render, montage, storyboard, voice, photo-aroll, motion or reference — picks the shape of the rest of the object. The reference kind takes the file raw/reference/<name>.mp4 and analyses it into a brief (get_reference_brief). The motion kind (only in a motion project) takes phase "storyboard", "video" or "all" (default), an optional output file name, takes 1 to 8 and overwrite. A full render (kind render, or motion with phase "video" or "all") is refused with PROPOSAL_NOT_APPROVED until the user approves a production proposal; render and motion also take sample {seconds: 8 to 20} for a short preview that is never blocked. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

sample.description: Render only the first N seconds (8 to 20) to out/<name>.sample.mp4 instead of the whole video. A sample is never blocked by the proposal approval, is not reviewed and can never be published.

skipProposal.description: Only when the user explicitly asked, in this chat, to render without approving a proposal first. Never set it on your own.

musicMode.description: bed (default): the music runs under everything and ducks while someone speaks. segments: the music plays full in the intro, the outro and the voice-free gaps of 2 s or more, with 0.6 s fades, and drops to a very low floor while someone speaks

musicFloorDb.description: Only with musicMode segments: how many dB below the full music level it sits while someone speaks; default -30

sample.description: Render only the first N seconds (8 to 20) to out/<name>.sample.mp4 instead of the whole video. A sample is never blocked by the proposal approval, is not reviewed and can never be published.

skipProposal.description: Only when the user explicitly asked, in this chat, to render without approving a proposal first. Never set it on your own.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Wait for a job to finish, up to timeoutSeconds. Returns early on completion, or with status "running" once the timeout elapses. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running or queued job. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Get the project timeline as it is currently persisted. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: put_timeline
tools.description: Replace the project timeline in full with a new, already valid timeline. Rejects a timeline whose caption words differ from what is saved — for example lost accents — unless editCaptions is true because the user explicitly asked to change the caption text. For a change that never touches the words (logo, intro/outro plates, music level, caption style, safe zone) use patch_timeline instead. Accepts the timeline as an object, or as a JSON string that parses to one. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

mode.description: segments: music plays full in the intro, the outro and the voice-free gaps of 2 s or more and drops to duckedGainDb while someone speaks; absent means the continuous bed.

sfxKind.description: Leave it out: the bumper already sounds by itself, following its logo reveal. Set it only when the user names a sound (whoosh, impact, shimmer, click) or asks for silence (none).

sfx.description: Explicit sound cues with a sound bank id; leave it out unless the user asks for an exact sound at an exact moment.

sfxKind.description: Leave it out: the bumper already sounds by itself, following its logo reveal. Set it only when the user names a sound (whoosh, impact, shimmer, click) or asks for silence (none).

sfx.description: Explicit sound cues with a sound bank id; leave it out unless the user asks for an exact sound at an exact moment.

kind.description: lower-third: a name or topic with a short line under it; chapter-title: the title of a new section, with an optional number; kinetic-text: one short phrase that enters word by word.

startMs.description: Start on the final timeline, in ms from the first frame after the intro bumper.

subtitle.description: Second line of a lower-third or chapter-title; ignored by kinetic-text.

eyebrow.description: Small label over a chapter-title, such as its number ("01"); ignored by the other kinds.

variant.description: Leave it out: the studio rotates the animation so two overlays of the same kind never enter alike. Set it only when the user asks for a specific look.

placement.description: Leave it out: each kind goes to a screen margin that keeps the recorded interface visible.

tools.name: patch_timeline
tools.description: Replace only the given sections of the already saved timeline — logo, bumpers, audioMix, captionStyle, safeZone, the music track and/or the textOverlays (lower thirds, chapter titles, kinetic phrases) — without touching captions, voice or any other word. Reads the current timeline, replaces just those sections, validates the result and saves it. Use this for a logo, an intro/outro plate, the music level, the caption style or on-screen titles instead of put_timeline, which forces you to re-send every caption word. Fails if the project has no timeline yet. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

sfxKind.description: Leave it out: the bumper already sounds by itself, following its logo reveal. Set it only when the user names a sound (whoosh, impact, shimmer, click) or asks for silence (none).

sfx.description: Explicit sound cues with a sound bank id; leave it out unless the user asks for an exact sound at an exact moment.

textOverlays.description: The whole list of on-screen texts (lower thirds, chapter titles, kinetic phrases); null removes them all.

tools.name: search_free_music
tools.description: Search freely licensed music matching a mood, up to maxResults results: first the music bank of the project's brand (source brand-bank, already tagged for tutorial, product, vertical or institutional videos and ordered so the least recently used come first), then Openverse (Jamendo music under CC BY, CC0 or public domain; never share-alike) and last Wikimedia Commons. Put the kind of video in the mood (e.g. "calm tutorial"). Use the returned resultId with import_music. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: import_music
tools.description: Bring a previously searched music result into raw/audio/ and record its credit in work/credits.json. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: search_free_media
tools.description: Search Wikimedia Commons and the NASA Image and Video Library for freely licensed B-roll video or photos matching a query, up to maxResults results. Use the returned resultId with import_media. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Download a previously searched free media result into raw/broll/ (video) or raw/images/ (image) and record its credit in work/credits.json. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: view_images
tools.description: Look at up to 6 photos already in the project and get them back as images. Use this to see a photo instead of extract_frames, which only works on video. Besides project paths (raw/images/x.png) it accepts brand:<key> to see a photo of the project brand (the keys come with their caption in the brand section of the project). The studio records every image you actually looked at: review_material only accepts those. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: get_motion_brands
tools.description: List the brands a motion video can use (built-in and user-made, each with its `source`), with the formats (16:9, 9:16) each supports and its music tracks (id, mood, bpm, hasDrop). Only for motion projects.

tools.name: read_motion_brief
tools.description: Read the motion brief saved for this project. Fails with FILE_NOT_FOUND when none was written yet. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: write_motion_brief
tools.description: Save the motion brief (version 1, brand, script and one captioned entry per image in raw/images/) for this project, replacing the previous one. When the user or the material gives the position of elements in an image (buttons, fields, cards), copy them into that image `boxes` as {name, x, y, w, h} fractions 0-1 exactly as given: the storyboard then points highlights, zooms and clicks at those boxes by name. A box you measured yourself on a capture (not given by the user or the material) must carry `source: "measured"`; the studio stamps who and when, and a measured box can never replace a given one of the same name. The studio validates it and answers with the offending field in the hint when it is invalid: fix that field and call again. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: read_motion_storyboard
tools.description: Read the motion storyboard (the scenes, each with its kind and voice line) that the storyboard phase produced. Fails with FILE_NOT_FOUND when it does not exist yet. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: write_motion_storyboard
tools.description: Save an edited motion storyboard (the whole JSON read with read_motion_storyboard, with your minimal changes), replacing the previous one. The studio validates it and answers with the offending field in the hint when it is invalid: fix that field and call again. Then re-render with start_job {"kind":"motion","phase":"video","overwrite":true}. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: set_voice_direction
tools.description: Direct how the voice is delivered. directions: { "<script line number>": direction } for a scripted narration; sceneDirections: { "<scene id>": direction | null } for the scenes of a narrated storyboard (work/storyboard.json). A direction carries pace (slow, normal, fast), energy (calm, neutral, lively), pauseAfterMs (0 to 2000), intent and emphasis (words that appear in that line or scene narration). The studio names the bad field when invalid. Then run the voice job with overwrite true so the directed lines or scenes are re-voiced. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

directions.description: Script-line directions keyed by line number; replaces the whole file, so send every directed line.

sceneDirections.description: Storyboard-scene directions keyed by scene id; null clears that scene. Scenes you leave out keep theirs.

tools.name: get_render_review
tools.description: Read the automatic review of a finished render: its status (pass, warn, fail), the key metrics (master LUFS and true peak, voice/music margin) and the findings by severity (critical, suggestion, nitpick), each with its time range and the proposed fix. For a motion video it also lists `sceneFrames` (the frames of each scene — several when it is long or names more than one thing — to look at with view_images) and `visualReviewState` (pending until record_visual_review is called). Without `file` it returns the most recent review; with `file` (for example out/video.mp4) that render's. Fails with FILE_NOT_FOUND when the render was never reviewed. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: record_visual_review
tools.description: Record, with evidence, that you looked at every scene of a render. After get_render_review lists `sceneFrames` (the frames of each scene, with the voice text), look at them with view_images (up to 6 per call) and send `scenes`: one entry per sceneId with `shows` (what the frame really shows, one line), `matchesVoice`, `legible`, `couldBeOtherProduct` (booleans), `verdict` (ok or fix) and `note` (required when the scene is flagged: what to change). The studio refuses a review that misses a scene or leaves any frame of any scene unviewed after the review was created (VISUAL_REVIEW_NOT_VIEWED). The critical finding visual-not-reviewed disappears; every scene marked fix, off the voice, illegible or ambiguous becomes a critical finding that blocks publishing until you fix it and re-render. Without `file` it uses the most recent review. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: review_material
tools.description: Record, with evidence, what the supplied material really is before you propose anything. `items` has one entry per image you looked at with view_images: `file` (the project path, for example raw/images/x.png, or brand:<key>), `source` (project or brand), `shows` (what the image actually shows, one line), `useFor` (the scene or role you would give it, optional), `verdict` (fits, doubtful or unfit) and `reason`. `gaps` lists what the idea needs and the material does not bring (`need`, `note`); send [] when there is none. The studio refuses an image you did not view (MATERIAL_NOT_VIEWED). propose_production fails with MATERIAL_NOT_REVIEWED until this review covers every project image. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

shows.description: What the image actually shows, in one line.

tools.name: propose_production
tools.description: Save the production proposal the user must approve before the first full render: 2 or 3 concepts, each with an id, title, angle, output format preset, durationSec, scenes, delivery contract ({kind: tutorial, motion or short, ...}), and optionally voiceId, musicMode and notes, plus the recommendedId. It first requires review_material to cover every project image (MATERIAL_NOT_REVIEWED) and the studio copies the unfit and doubtful images and the gaps into the proposal as warnings. It replaces any earlier proposal and leaves it pending: only the user approves it, in the studio. Time and cost estimates are computed by the studio, never by you. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

angle.description: The creative approach in one or two sentences.

tools.name: get_reference_brief
tools.description: Read what the studio learned from a reference video (a file under raw/reference/ that the user wants theirs to feel like). `references` always lists every analysed reference with its summary; without `name`, `brief` is null; with `name` (the file name without extension, for example modelo) `brief` is its full analysis: duration, format, the scenes with start, end and keyframe image, the pace (cuts per minute, mean and median scene length), the voice (transcript phrases with times, words per minute, speech ratio) and the audio (loudness, long silences). Fails with FILE_NOT_FOUND when that reference was never analysed: start_job {"kind":"reference","file":"raw/reference/<name>.mp4"} analyses it. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: List what this project already published on YouTube, its items waiting in the publish queue (status, url, nextAttemptAt, lastError) and the queue state (paused, dailyLimit, publishedLast24h). Call it before proposing a publication. Pass `slug`: the project this applies to.

slug.description: The video project this call applies to (the slug from list_projects or create_project)
